mark title
press A

press A

press A

press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)

wait 600
mark salen              # the five come out after A one by one (the last one lifted inside first)
wait 3000
mark ruedo              # into Ganon's ring, the five behind A
place 11.80 100.10 -1.10
wait 300
wait 2400               # the intro (our cutscene: the puppets out of sight meanwhile)
wait 900                # the six in the ring; no fight here (final-ganon-*)
